name: Kilo for GitHub
desc: Kilo agent that works on issues and pull requests inside GitHub.
desc_zh: 在 GitHub 里处理 Issue 和 Pull Request 的 Kilo 智能体。
solves: Assigning work to an agent meant leaving GitHub and pasting context; the agent is mentioned in the thread and works there.
solves_zh: 给智能体派活要先离开 GitHub 再贴上下文；现在在话题里@它，它就在原地干活。
best_for: A backlog of labelled issues should become pull requests without anyone opening an editor.
best_for_zh: 一堆带标签的 Issue 应该直接变成 Pull Request，没人需要开编辑器。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — blog.kilo.ai directory）。 kilo.ai/github redirects to the Kilo Code GitHub organisation page. 首次公开日期来源：https://blog.kilo.ai/p/introducing-kilo-for-github 官网未直接确认（redirect->https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode）。
